sections.title: Overview
items: For the base game story arcs with the same name, see Story Arcs (Classic Game). Story Arcs

Story Arcs is the term for additional story-based playable content that advances the storyline beyond the base Classic Game. Story Arcs includes both Chapters and Episodes, both of which are free DLC. Story Arcs can also refer to groups of Episodes or Chapters within the larger continuity that have a more consecutive plotline.
Chronologically, Story Arcs content has increasing requirements for combat rating of the player character. They are grouped and arranged by Tier.

From Episode 30: Earth 3 onwards, all players with a minimum level (typically Level 20) can access an easier version of Instance content via Casual difficulty mode. While within, their CR is boosted to the minimum needed.
Since Episode 41: House of Legends, all episode content no longer has a CR cap limiting rewards of Source Marks.
All Story Arcs content is also free-to-play.

Story Arcs expand the story of the base Classic Game, but do not affect the Classic Game―which takes place before all Episodes and Chapters. Episodes, and later Chapters, themselves form a continuity according to their chronological order of release.

sections.title: Multi-Episode/Chapter Story Arcs
items: While story elements in subsequent Episodes or Chapters always build the story arc continuity from previous content, the following have a more cohesive plotline binding them together.

sections.title: War of the Light
items: The War of the Light story arc sees the various factions of the Lantern Corps team up first to fight Brainiac whose attacks in Metropolis have damaging consequences across the Emotional Spectrum and throughout the Lantern Corps. As the War and corruption spreads from Earth to Zamaron, Mogo, Ranx, and even Oa, Parallax the Black Lanterns, Black Hand, and risen Nekron threaten all of life itself. The fate of the Universe hangs in the balance. Join the fight!

sections.title: Sons of Trigon
items: Circe and Brother Blood were successful in releasing Trigon from his dimension, but the Sentinels of Magic trapped Trigon between his world and ours, resulting in the in-between dimension, Gotham Wastelands. With Trigon at his most vulnerable, his sons came forth to vie for his power. The Sons of Trigon sought the family reunion from Hell, and to be joined with Pride― Raven―and their father to gain ultimate power. The sons sent demons to the mortal plane to abduct innocent souls in order to torture and extract enough sin needed to awaken Trigon from his forced slumber. Meanwhile, Wonder Woman and the Titans tried to keep Raven from temptation, and to stop the children of sin from releasing their father and endanger the entire universe. Brother Blood's schemes for ultimate power reached a new level as he used Raven and the Sons of Trigon to collect even more power. Raven sensed a disturbance in the levels of sinful energy in the Gotham Wastelands' Desecrated Cathedral. Players joined Raven as she confronted Trigon to stop him from once again gaining enough power to destroy the mortal world. In the aftermath, her panicked brothers scrambled for power and turned on each other. Jesse (Envy) caused Julius (Gluttony) to envy their brother Jacob (Lust) resulting in the hungriest brother becoming insatiable in his desires for food AND power. The Gotham Wastelands continued to be full of mayhem and madness. Imps and demons run amuck in the fiery wasteland, allowing Jacob and Jack (Sloth) to seductively and slowly (respectively) make their moves. Raven, annoyed as ever by her brothers, once again asked for the player's help putting them back in their places.

sections.title: Amazon Fury
items: Hippolyta, Queen of the Amazons, seemed to have gone mad as she aligned herself with Circe. Wonder Woman rallied an army together to help fight for Themyscira and to help defend Gotham City from the attacking Amazons. The Amazonian war spread from the mortal realm into the divine as all involved sought to uncover what was really happening with Hippolyta and Hades. The story arc has the player face impossible trials spanning Themyscira, Battle-torn Gotham City, the Underworld, and even Olympus itself.

sections.title: Halls of Power
items: Darkseid sent his agents below the surfaces of New Genesis and Apokolips to gather relics so that he could harness the power of the Old Gods by recovering ancient Third World artifacts. At the same time, a skirmish broke out on the surface of New Genesis as Darkseid's forces attempted to attack Celestial City. Granny Goodness also was testing the mettle of Earth's heroes and villains in an attempt to recruit and prepare the denizens of Apokolips to serve Darkseid. For a while, it seemed that Earth was safe from Darkseid's meddling, until war between the New Gods once again heated up on New Genesis, and players reported to the battle site to help defend the area from Darkseid's invasion force. Though the players triumphed over Steppenwolf, he left with an eerie message: "The Source will speak to Darkseid." Darkseid finally gathered enough Artifacts of the Old Gods to reshape them into a machine that would allow him to access the all-powerful Source―which would mean his will could never be defeated. Stop him!

sections.title: League of Assassins
items: The League of Assassins continues to attempt to exert their control over the DC Universe. Players traveled through a rift in time and space to the world of the DC Bombshells to battle the "Bombshell" Talia al Ghul. In her attempts to alter their timeline and change the outcome of World War II, the Lady al Ghul created a tear in reality itself! Next, the League broke into the Flash Museum in Central City, in what looked to be an attempt to steal an artifact from an alternate reality― Talia Al Ghul's scimitar! Players navigated through the museum to keep the artifact out of the League of Assassins' hands, and discover what they are plotting next. When heroes and villains arrived at the Lazarus Pools, they found the unconscious hanging bodies of their allies from the Justice League and the Society. Having been submerged into the Pools, heroes and villains had to fight against their allies in an attempt to reverse the effects of the serums. Finally, we discover that Ra's al Ghul's madness is greater than it has ever been. But rather than an all-out assault on any one of the world's 'great' cities, he has captured Star City's hero, Green Arrow, and Central City's nefarious rogue, Captain Cold, to recruit them to his cause. Players fought alongside Black Canary or Heat Wave against The Demon's forces in the infamous mountain fortress of Nanda Parbat.

sections.title: Legends of Tomorrow
items: Once upon a time, heroes and villains fought to recover Kahndaqi relics from the control of the mysterious Abra Kadabra in the Gotham University Warehouse. Heat Wave and Hawkgirl were forced to work together in order to regain control of the relics. With the player's help they succeeded―except for one piece that vanished. A mysterious stranger thanked everyone for their assistance, and promised to be back in touch soon…. Then, the same mysterious contact asked the player to work with the latest member of his Team of Legends, the Atom to break out a recently incarcerated individual from maximum security in Stryker's Island. The prison break plan ended in a huge face-off with Doctor Light, and the stranger promising he'll contact them with more information later on. The Legends of Tomorrow adventure continued as the player met up with Vixen at the Mercenary Base. She thought she'd tracked down the missing piece from Gotham U Warehouse, and needed your help to get it back. Also... who is this mysterious stranger and what are his motives? There's only one way to find out!

sections.title: Refreshing Kandor
items: After a bit of trouble in the Fortress of Solitude, Lois Lane investigates The Science Spire and realized the Kryptonian sightings there were connected to General Zod seeking information from Lex Luthor's database concerning the location of the Bottle City of Kandor. The location of Kandor aboard Brainiac's Bottle Ship became known by Zod, and he took possession of the Bottled City following the ensuing battle on board. Although still trapped within Brainiac’s bottle, Zod situated Kandor near the Fortress of Solitude and returned the city to normal size. Zod sought to sway the citizens of Kandor to his cause and raise an army of Kryptonians to rule the planet. Heroes joined Superman, Superboy, and Supergirl in Kandor to convince everyone that Humans and Kryptonians can share the planet and live in peace, while Villains joined Lex Luthor in Kandor to prepare to evict its people from Earth.

sections.title: The Gotham Girls
items: Harley Quinn, Poison Ivy, and Catwoman are at it again! The three attempted a caper at the Regal Hotel. But one little heist doesn’t pack enough punch for this trio, so they showed up at the grand opening of Penguin’s new club, the Iceberg Lounge. The girls quickly learned that crossing the Penguin at his big event may have been more than they bargained for, since Catwoman ended up kidnapped! Though she was safely rescued, this gave Harley and Ivy another idea... one that Catwoman was not too thrilled with. Wayne Manor: filled to the brim with Gotham’s elite, all rallied together for a charity event raising funds for victims of the Brainiac Invasion. The soiree was, of course, hosted by Bruce Wayne―only Bruce wassn’t seen to be milling among the crowd. Could Harley, Ivy, and Selina have had something to do with that? It’s up to you to find out!

sections.title: Atlantis
items: STARRO LIVES! The intergalactic starfish parasites invaded once again! Heroes and villains alike banded together and resisted its influence, fighting their way through the alien intrusion from the chaotic streets of Central City, to an isolated Atlantean Research Outpost, in an effort to discover the source of the invasion and how to stop it! Players discovered there was more lingering beneath the surface of this invasion, and needed to journey to Spindrift Station to clear the waters on what was really going on. Following the events at Spindrift Station, it was dark times for the once beautiful undersea paradise of Atlantis as Corum Rath looked to take the throne from Aquaman and Mera. Players needed to assist the underground resistance in Atlantis for there to be any chance to save the kingdom. Then players joined Aqualad and King Shark in infiltrating the shadowy halls of the Silent School on a dangerous quest to recover the Trident of Poseidon. Finally, Mera and Ocean Master led players to fight their way through the Crown of Thorns into the heart of the Palace itself for the final battle with the deadly usurper himself – Corum Rath! Everyone’s help was needed in the fight to end his reign and restore Atlantis to its former glory as the mad king definitely had a big surprise up his sleeve!

sections.title: The Source Saga
items: Jack Kirby as the manifestation of The Source - Green Lantern #12, 2022

Arguably, the biggest Saga in DC Universe Online history! The race for Metal began with Batman disappearing as Dark Multiverse energy infected people in Gotham City, turning them into threats. The Batman Who Laughs cracked open Arkham Asylum, sending escaped inmates to run amok. Twisted alternate versions of Batman known as The Dark Knights and the Justice League scoured the universe for rare forms of Metal―the keys to victory in the war between the Multiverse and the Darkness. As heroes and villains alike teamed up across Earth, Oa, Themyscira, Olympus, and even inside The Batcave, the Bruce Waynes of the Dark Multiverse hatched plans of their own.

As Earth sank into the Dark Multiverse, Thanagar aimed a world-destroying gun at Earth to prevent other worlds from following suit. With Batman recovered, players teamed-up to journey through Batman's nightmares, Atlantis' Silent School, and Oa's Sciencells, battling the Dark Knights before diving headlong into the Forge of Worlds at the heart of the Dark Multiverse. To save reality from crumbling, players needed to first defeat Dawnbreaker, The Drowned, and the Bat God Barbatos, leader of the Dark Knights! But at what cost... The Source Wall was cracked releasing the Source energy into the universe.

Metropolis descended into a battle royale after Lex Luthor broadcasts to the world that he's leaving his wealth, technology, and weapons to anyone willing to take them. Crime was rampant and the Birds of Prey are on the case! Lex was revealed to have harnessed Apokoliptian technology back in Darkseid's War Factory to gain the power of Source energy, which he used to become Alpha Lex Luthor, a nod to his half-Martian form, Apex Lex, in DC's Year of the Villain event. In the comic book event, Lex blew himself up in his tower to prove his devotion to Perpetua so be could help her ascend to power. This is similar to how, in the game, the Birds of Prey episode indirectly leads to Perpetua's rise in Legion of Doom.

The Multiverse started collapsing due to the rupturing of The Source Wall, and the damage spread to the Sphere of the Gods. Universes collided with each other, and All gods―Greek, Old, and even New―threw the dimensionally-patchwork-merged Themyscira into complete war and chaos as they tried to recover and steal Source Wall fragments for their own power. The Wonder Woman of our universe joined forces with Wonder Women from four different universes, forming the Council of Wonder Women to rise up against the gods. With the player's help, their efforts to find the fragments to repair The Source Wall were hoped to be enough to save the multiverse as a whole. But another power lurked in the background with even more sinister plans...
Next, The Monitor summoned all heroes and villains to his House of Legends to train, coordinate, and prepare for a looming multiversal threat.

Perpetua, the nigh-omnipotent cosmic master, arrived and unleashed chaos, destruction, and Doom so that she could rise to power and rewrite the Multiverse in her doomed image! Alpha Lex Luthor asked villains to serve her via his new Legion of Doom. Heroes joined Martian Manhunter in forming a cosmic team powerful enough to oppose her. Mister Mxyzptlk agreed to help, but something about it felt off. Still, he opened the way to the Sixth Dimension where the World Forger could be found. The best chance to defeat Perpetua and her Doom was to unite her sons against her. If her son, World Forger, could be convinced to join the cause, and if the Monitor could recruit the Anti-Monitor... there might be a chance.

Finally, Perpetua's plans to undo, remake, and destroy the Multiverse were nearly complete. The Hall of Justice and most of Washington D.C. were in ruins. The world's heroes and villains must cut off Perpetua's power and stop her once and for all, but time was running out. Grail agreed to help Wonder Woman weaken Perpetua's power on New Apokolips: ending Darkfather's cruel reign. Lex Luthor and Death Metal Batman led the charge against a major source of Perpetua’s power: her throne on Earth 3; but first forces needed to take on the Crime Syndicate. It was time to take the fight to Perpetua! Players met Wonder Woman at The Source Wall ready to fight to preserve the Multiverse.

sections.title: Light and Rain
items: The Light and Rain Story Arc focuses on sisters Esperanza and Luzia Cavalera and how events in their lives both in Kaznia and on Mogo escalate and have wide-ranging results across the universe. In Kaznia City, a string of mysterious murders targeting exobyte-powered individuals seemed to be similar to cases in Gotham City and sent shockwaves through the streets. Players teamed up with occult detective John Constantine, new local hero Voivode, and Esperanza to uncover a web of supernatural secrets and discoveries concerning the mysterious The Reckoning. Next, fallen hero turned Indigo Lantern Luzia recruited the player to aid with an invasion occurring on the sentient planet Mogo. Many Lanterns assembled there to help, including her sister, Esperanza – who then went missing. Luzia uncovered an alarming plan led by Amon Sur of the Yellow Lanterns; a plan that threatened the very fate of Mogo itself. Her attempt to save her sister and stop the impending doom while still coping with the fallout from her past mistakes, led to a shocking fate and saw both sisters pay a tremendous price.

Following Lyssa Drak's deeds, and overcome with despair, Luzia transformed into a Gray Lantern. The powerful sorrow energy radiating from her was enough for Mogo to become similarly changed into a mournful world shrouded in grief. Using Luzia's pain together with Mogo's corrupted Power Core as a catalyst to spread sorrow energy that drains and weakens other Lanterns, Lyssa unleashed Nekron and the Black Lanterns as key leaders of the Lantern Corps were taken hostage one-by-one. With sorrow spreading unchecked to serve a darker purpose, the player fought alongside Kyle Rayner to save as many as possible and challenge the embodiment of death itself before it was too late. The Gray power of Sorrow continued to overtake Mogo, and cast a shadow that even the brightest rings struggled to cut through. Mogo, once mournful, stood on the brink of becoming something far worse: frozen, shattered, lost forever, and a potential threat to spread sorrow throughout the universe. Luzia’s despair also reached a critical point, and unless she was reached in time, the living planet would not survive. Guy Gardner issued a call for help―because this time, the Lanterns alone may not be enough. However, the Player soon discovered that things didn't add up. Refugees were being gathered under Red Lantern supervision. Families were being separated, and children were disappearing without explanation. Beneath the Red Lanterns' fury, something else was unfolding. They're not just out of control...they're concealing something. Players stood with the Lantern Corps as hope and will clashed against rage and despair before ascending into the heart of Luzia’s despair to confront sorrow head-on and prove that hope still burns bright.

sections.title: Children of Krypton
items: Continuing on from Light and Rain, the hunt for Kryb and the search for Hope Cavalera led to the depths of the Atlantic within the submerged remains of Argo City, the lost Kryptonian sanctuary, and the birthplace of Supergirl! The living nightmare known as Kryb seized control of the Atlanteans within Argo through terrifying mind manipulation, turning them into her personal army. As innocent captives disappeared into Kryb's twisted experiments, the rulers of Atlantis called out for aid. With Supergirl leading the charge and allies like Aquaman, Mera, Blue Lantern Luzia, and Krypto joining the fight, players must uncover Kryb’s twisted experiments and push back the spreading influence threatening both Atlantean and Kryptonian legacies.

sections.title: Notes
items: Additional content to the game was originally labeled DLC packs and could contain new powers, upgrades and Legends characters besides new playable content. On March 31st, 2015, Episode playable content was separated from powers, upgrades and Legends characters that were previously included in similarly named DLC packs. DLC packs or episode content were included in an active membership or could be bought as single items in the marketplace, until June 2021 when all episodes became free to play.

Game Update 151 changed "Event" difficulty to "Story Mode" difficulty (level 20+). All episode content that previously had an Event version (episodes starting from Earth 3) now had a Story difficulty version. Open world parts of all episodes are now available from level 20+.; The Day of Reckoning update renamed "Story" difficulty mode to "Casual".
Halls of Power Part II was the last quarterly episode, until Amazon Fury Part III, starting a new cycle of large episodes.

Episodes 15 - 26 were released on a monthly basis containing: one piece of content for large groups (raid, operation, or alert) with the other piece of content for small groups (solo, challenge, or duo).

Previously, there were periods called Open Episodes during which most or all episodes were free to play with some limitations. During the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, episodes went free-to-play. On June 15th, 2021, this became permanent and Episodes were removed from the marketplace.; Free players can purchase fixed-level Iconic Battle Suits (e.g. War-Metal) from respective vendors, or episode iconic styles from Vending Unit 00 (e.g. Shepherd of Adara) with Source Marks.; They could also receive Catalyst (Augments) drops, obtain Adaptive Augments and level them up, unlike in the event version.
While The Death of Superman does not contain or increase the episode number, its feats are located in the "Story Arcs" category, meaning the game does classify it as one.

Many On Duty instances (especially from earlier releases) are named directly after the location used in the instance. This has led to the location and the On Duty instances often being confused or referred to interchangeably, even though as the game expanded, many instances now have multiple locations and often reuse old locations.

title: Adaptive Augments
summary: Adaptive Augments are a category of Augments that are specific to an episode or chapter. They were introduced with game update 85, along with the Teen Titans: The Judas Contract episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Adaptive Augments are a category of Augments that are specific to an episode or chapter. They were introduced with game update 85, along with the Teen Titans: The Judas Contract episode.

sections.title: The System
items: Adaptive Augments have additional stats for overall content, as well as bonuses for their specific content. There are five types:
Dominating Augments (purple) are dedicated to improve Dominance and Health, while also providing some extra Power. Recommended for Tank roles.
Mighty Augments (red) are dedicated to improve Might and Weaponization, while also providing some extra Health and Power. Recommended for Damage roles focused on Superpowers.
Precise Augments (yellow) are dedicated to improve Precision and Weaponization, while also providing some extra Health and Power. Recommended for Damage roles focused on Weapons.
Restoring Augments (green) are dedicated to improve Restoration and Power, while also providing some extra Health. Recommended for Healer roles.
Vital Augments (blue) are dedicated to improve Vitalization and Power, while also providing some extra Health. Recommended for Controller roles.

Players can equip their augments by accessing the Augments tab in their Inventory menu. Each character has 2 slots dedicated to Adaptive Augments, which are listed under their own subsection. They are listed by item level from highest to lowest, and augments of the same level are listed in alphabetical order.

sections.title: Fortifying
items: When you acquire a new Adaptive Augment, its rank is 0. In order to make the augment stronger and unlock content-specific bonuses, they must be fortified on the Fortify tab in the Inventory menu. They are sorted using the same criteria as the Augments tab, except that any Augment equipped by the player will appear on the top of the list, and maxed out augments won't be listed.

To advance ranks, Adaptive Augments must be fed Exobytes. Upon reaching a threshold, they can only breakthrough by using content-specific catalysts — they can be acquired from content drops and Omnibus Reward Caches, or they can be bought from episode/chapter vendors or from the broker (if other players are selling them). The higher the rank, the more Exobytes and catalysts are required to rank up. Maxed out Adaptive Augments will have a silver frame around them. Ranking these augments will also unlock specific feats.

While Adaptive Augments from "Latest Episodes" (the three most recent Episodes or Chapters as shown in the On Duty tab) can only be fed with Exobytes from their specific content, the previously released Augments can be fed with any type of Exobyte. It is also possible to feed Adaptive Augments with other Adaptive Augments, thereby transferring the XP. The fortification rules below provide more detail.
There are two groupings of Content-Specific Exobytes and Adaptive Augments that limit fortification within each group:

Latest Episodes - the 3 most recent episodes or chapters; Content-Specific Exobytes from Latest Episodes can only be fed to their own episode's Augments.; Adaptive Augments from Latest Episodes cannot be fed with Exobytes from any other episodes.; Adaptive Augments from Latest Episodes can be fed with other Adaptive Augments from Latest Episodes to indirectly gain Exobyte xp through them, typically with a 50% XP penalty during fortification. (As of the release of The Sins of Black Adam.); Adaptive Augments from Latest Episodes cannot be fed to any of the Adaptive Augments from Earlier Episodes.

Earlier Episodes- all episodes/chapters earlier than the 3 most recent; Content-Specific Exobytes from Earlier Episodes can be used to fortify Origin Augments and Adaptive Augments from Earlier Episodes.; Adaptive Augments from Earlier Episodes can also be fortified with generic Exobytes.; Adaptive Augments from Earlier Episodes can be fed with other Adaptive Augments from Earlier Episodes to indirectly gain Exobyte xp through them, typically with a 50% XP penalty during fortification.; Adaptive Augments from Earlier Episodes cannot be fed to any of the Adaptive Augments from Latest Episodes.

sections.title: Acquiring Adaptive Augments
items: Access to the content in question is required and they offer special bonuses within the specific content - although their base stats will still apply outside of it.

When a character reaches the minimum CR for a specific content, a mission would appear in the journal that can be immediately completed to gain 2 free Adaptive Augment boxes that would allow you to choose 2 Adaptive Augments. Grants have also been used to distribute the initial set of augments.

As of the release of The Sins of Black Adam, Adaptive Augments from the three most recent episodes ( Legion of Doom, Dark Knights, The Sins of Black Adam) are bought with their specific episode currency (5 each). All those from previous episodes can be bought at episode vendors for 5 Source Marks each (completing the aforementioned mission is not required), and their catalysts may also be bought for various amounts of Source Marks or episode currencies.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Adaptive Augments have undergone changes over the years:; Initially, four rank bonuses were available requiring dedicated exobytes of Flawed, Solid, and Pristine qualities. The Augments had common rarity at rank 0, and could be leveled to rank 23--which required four different varieties of catalysts to achieve. Precise Augment bonuses would grant +5% Precision and Weaponization Rating. Two Adaptive Augments were rewarded via missions available during an episode release window.; Atlantis episode reduced the variety of catalysts to three.; The Wonderverse episode introduced event-level (weaker) Adaptive Augments and exobytes of Flawless and Timeless qualities. Adaptive Augments now have six rank bonuses available. Precise Augment bonuses would now also grant +4% Precision and Weaponization Rating. Augments missions were replaced by the Grant system.; Long Live the Legion episode's augments had rare rarity at rank 0.; World of Flashpoint episode's augments had artifact rarity at rank 0.; With the Legion of Doom episode, augments now have eight rank bonuses available. Exobytes qualities were reduced to Solid, Pristine, and Flawless. Adaptive Augments had common rarity at rank 0 once again, and could be leveled to rank 28.; With The Sins of Black Adam episode, augments now have seven rank bonuses available.; With Light and Rain: Raging Night, the variety of catalysts and exobytes were reduced to one each.

While their secondary effects appears to unlock at a low level, Adaptive Augments require much more experience to level up. A regular artifact requires about 40,000 experience to reach level 80 when the first tier is unlocked, while Adaptive Augments vary depending on the CR of the episode: even the lowest CR option, Cybernetic Cores, require a whopping 346,987 experience to reach level 15 to unlock the first effect.

Game Update 171introduced the following changes to fortification:; To reduce clutter, the Fortify tab no longer displays max-rank artifacts or augments.; Selecting a large stack of reagents will now only insert into the preview as many items as are needed to reach the next Milestone Rank. You can still select the reagents a second time to use the entire stack if you wish.
Prior to Game Update 172, Adaptive Augments were listed by rank from highest to lowest, and augments with the same rank were listed in alphabetical order.

title: Atlantis: Royal Palace
summary: Atlantis: Royal Palace is a Tier 5 Challenge in Atlantis released in November 2018.

sections.title: Overview
items: Atlantis: Royal Palace is a Tier 5 Challenge in Atlantis released in November 2018.
Access to Atlantis: Royal Palace requires a Combat Rating of 210 for Normal mode, or Level 15+ for Casual.

sections.title: Introduction
items: The House of Atlan has been summoned to the Throne Room of Atlantis. Mera and Aquaman have invited you as a special guest in their court. (Heroes)
The House of Atlan has been summoned to the Throne Room of Atlantis. Ocean Master, known to the Atlanteans as Orm, has invited you to join them as a special guest in their court. (Villains)

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Warning: This section might contain spoilers!

There is a monitor that allows you to skip most cutscenes in this instance to the right on the path to the throne room (the option only appears when you move close to it at or below its level; if you swim above it, it doesn't appear no matter how close you are).
Talk to Aquaman/Ocean Master, and enter the room, where the Atlantean Royal Court strips Arthur of his title and accuses him of treason, crowning Corum Rath instead.

After defeating a few waves of his soldiers (there is a restoration barrel spawn at center-north of the room), he summons the deadly Crown of Thorns - an expanding thicket of dark red thorns that will instantly KO you when touched. It is functionally an "advancing wall of doom" that will start chasing you once you move a few steps away from it (however, if you are KO'ed, it will reset to the original position and not move forward until you do, allowing you to interact with Repairman Rodion). If you use warp rally before entering the boss room, it would teleport you behind the Crown and you will be instantly KO'ed.

You will need to keep moving while defeating more soldiers, although for the first couple of Drift Guards, you can hit them at your maximum range, so the wall won't start advancing until you beat them and move on, buying you some time. You must defeat a Drift Lieutenant to open each door behind them. The last door only requires you to interact with a switch - if you manage to finish interacting with it, any mobs chasing you will disappear as you go into cutscene. You can skip most of the fighting on the way simply by using Shield Powers like Telekinetic Shield, but only if the shields are strong enough to hold while you open the door.
In the final room is the boss, Commander Zoltar. Mera and Ocean Master will hold back the Crown of Thorns while you battle him. There is a restoration barrel on the east side of the chamber.

He starts the battle using Two-Handed; at 75%, 50%, and 25% health, he would jump to a random one of the weapon racks in the room: northwest weapon rack for a Shield, southeast rack for Dual Pistol, or northeast to use Two-Handed again (if you fight him in a spot too far from the rack, he will still jump and fall short, but still change weapons; he takes no damage during the jump and even if you stop him jumping with crown control, he still changes weapons and will sometimes blink to the rack).

Do not attack him when he is surrounded by a sphere of water, as this Water Reflection Shield will fully negate any damage you deal, and you will be hit for 5% of your max health for every hit you make against it. After defeating him, escape by activating the vortex with the machine on the west side of the chamber (this will land you at King Shark's Turf; alternatively you can simply leave by the usual yellow portal after you've completed it once before).

sections.title: Trivia
items: Story-wise, Atlantis: Royal Palace picks up where Deluge left off. A contender for the throne of Atlantis was revealed in one of the reports found in Starro: The Threat Below, and Corum Rath has destroyed Aquaman's embassy to the surface in Starro: Spindrift Station as a first major blow in his campaign against the House of Atlan.
The Royal Palace is revisited in Atlantis: The Throne as Aquaman attempts to retake his throne aided by his allies.
The instance needs to be completed once to unlock the episode's open world zone Atlantis.
At the first fight, there are two red dots on the minimap right where the locked doors are, but there are no fightable mobs there.

If you are KO'ed in the first fight and flee, you are placed outside the throne room. The room is then reset to a few mobs, and you can KO them from outside the room without retaliation. However, you need to reenter the room for further waves of mobs to spawn and for the instance to progress.

In the first fight, the mobs would generally prioritize targeting you, then Ocean Master and Mera, and rarely Aquaman. You need to defeat a number of them to progress; if you do not KO them, they would accumulate (2 would spawn every 20 seconds). Under unknown circumstances, it is possible for them to not target you at all, allowing them to accumulate seemingly indefinitely until an unknown trigger can cause hundreds of them to suddenly all target you at once. Ocean Master and Mera do not have health bars, but Aquaman does, and none of them actually damage the mobs with their attacks; theoretically it is possible for Aquaman to be KO'ed in the fight but it would take an extremely long time (in the realm of many hours) due to his high health.
The Crown of Thorns is shown to devour even soldiers loyal to Corum Rath in the cutscene. However, gameplay-wise, it does not affect them, Mera, Ocean Master, or even your pets.

If you use the monitor to skip cutscenes, you may still get the scene where you, Mera and Orm are sucked into the vortex, but both Mera and Orm may be invisible and their dialogue removed except for Orm's panicked screams.

There is a specific point just behind the second Drift Lieutenant in which you can get stuck and you will not be able to move. As rallying would teleport you behind the Crown, either way, you will be KO'ed.

items: Additional content to the game was originally labeled DLC packs and could contain new powers, upgrades and Legends characters besides new playable content. In March 2015 new playable content was relabeled episodes and would no longer feature any other upgrades. title: Episode
summary: An Episode is additional playable content to the Classic Game. Subsequent episodes have increasing requirements in terms of the combat rating of the player character, and are arranged by tier.

sections.title: Overview
items: An Episode is additional playable content to the Classic Game. Subsequent episodes have increasing requirements in terms of the combat rating of the player character, and are arranged by tier.

Starting from Earth 3, upon release of an episode, all players with a minimum level (no CR requirement) can access an easier version of its content now called Casual mode. Player's CR and stats are buffed as needed. This was originally called the Event version and was available until the release of the next episode. Casual mode versions of instances are now permanent and can be found in the On Duty Menu.
Since House of Legends (Episode), all episode content no longer has a CR cap regarding rewarding Source Marks, and all episodes are made permanently free to play as long as the minimum CR is reached.

While the story of episodes usually expands from the base game, the events that happen in episodes do not affect the base game (which can be considered to be taking place before all episodes). Episodes themselves form a continuity according to their chronological order of release.
With the advent of Chapters in 2025, Episodes and Chapters are both classified as components of Story Arcs in-game.

sections.title: Notes
items: Game Update 151 changed Event difficulty to Story Mode difficulty (level 20+). All episode content that previously had an event version (episodes starting from Earth 3) now has a Story difficulty version. Open world parts of all episodes are now available from level 20+.; The Day of Reckoning update renamed Story difficulty to Casual.
While The Death of Superman does not count towards the episode number, its feats are located in the "Episode" category, meaning the game does classify it as one.

Additional content to the game was originally labeled DLC packs and could contain new powers, upgrades and Legends characters besides new playable content. On March 31st, 2015, Episode playable content was separated from powers, upgrades and Legends characters that were previously included in similarly named DLC packs. DLC packs or episode content were included in an active membership or could be bought as single items in the marketplace, until Game Update 115 in June 2021 when all episodes became free to play.
Halls of Power Part II was the last quarterly episode, until Amazon Fury Part III, starting a new cycle of large episodes.

Episodes 15 - 26 were released on a monthly basis containing: one piece of content for large groups (raid, operation or alert) with the other piece of content for small groups (solo challenge or duo).

Previously, there were periods called Open Episodes during which most or all episodes were free to play with some limitations. During the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, episodes went free-to-play. On June 16th, 2021, this became permanent and episodes were removed from the marketplace.; Free players can purchase fixed-level Iconic Battle Suits (e.g. War-Metal) from respective vendors, or episode iconic styles from Vending Unit 00 (e.g. Shepherd of Adara) with Source Marks.; They could also receive Catalyst (Augments) drops, obtain Adaptive Augments and level them up, unlike in the event version.

Almost all On Duty instances that are pre-episodes or from the first 4 episodes (and still frequently in later episodes) are named directly after the location used in the instance. This has led to the location and the On Duty instances often being confused or referred to interchangeably, even though as the game expanded many instances now have multiple locations and often reuse old locations.

items: A series of murders occur in Gotham City behind the scenes, which are investigated by the Gotham City Police Department and covered by the press. Your investigation begins with the Day of Reckoning.Uncover the truth that sleeps within Kaznia City, where a string of mysterious murders sends shockwaves through the streets. Teaming up with occult detective John Constantine of Justice League Dark, you’re caught in a web of supernatural secrets and discoveries that will challenge everything you know. As the investigations progress, trust becomes a deadly gamble.Who can you rely on, and how many lives can you save before time runs out?

An in-game welcome page incorrectly referred to Day of Reckoning as "first of a three part story".
With the exception of Day of Reckoning, all chapters titles in Light and Rain are taken from the Blue Lantern Corps oath.

Luzia Cavalera is the only major character to appear in all chapters, and serves as an antagonist in all except Fearful Day, but is only fought directly in Day of Reckoning as The Reckoning. Luzia can be seen as the protagonist of Light & Rain, as she's the character who things happen to and whose internal transformations take front and center.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Omnibus system with its weekly extra rewards was introduced to make previous game content more attractive for replaying. This was also accompanied by the change to make all On Duty instances no longer have a CR cap for rewarding Source Marks.

It seems the "random" instance is influenced by any players who are already queuing for specific instances. This is most apparent with Event Progression, e.g. as Zamaron Conversion Chamber counts towards the Valentine's Day Event, queuing for Omnibus Alerts during the event has a higher chance of getting it.
Omnibus Weekly missions were rebranded as A.R.G.U.S. Weekly missions with Game Update 171.

sections.title: Overview
items: Winter Holidays, also known as Season's Greedings, is a Christmas-themed seasonal event that occurs throughout the month of December.
The event showcases Christmas throughout Metropolis and Gotham City and features Christmas-themed items and unique missions and locations for the Player Character to explore.
This event was first released with Game Update 7: Season's Greedings on December 12, 2011.

Larfleeze, the Orange Lantern of Avarice, has discovered the season of giving and wants all of the seasonal gifts for himself. Green Lantern (Hal Jordan) and Sinestro recruit various New Heroes and New Villains to stop Larfleeze and return the gifts to their rightful owners.

In addition to stealing presents, Larfleeze takes advantage of the conflict between the Green Lantern Corps and Sinestro Corps in Metropolis and steals their rings; hoarding them in a Secret Research Facility in order to bolster the power of his own Orange Lantern Corps.

title: Springtime
summary: Springtime is a spring-themed seasonal event that occurs in the months of April and/or May.

sections.title: Overview
items: Springtime is a spring-themed seasonal event that occurs in the months of April and/or May.

The event showcases Spring throughout Gotham City and features Spring-themed items and unique missions and locations for the Player Character to explore. Players complete missions to earn event currency tokens Seed Pods to spend on rewards at the seasonal event vendors.
The introductory mission for heroes as well as villains is Poisonous Desire.

sections.title: Spring 2011-2012
items: The 2011 event did not have playable event content. In 2022, the following Story driven content was released:
Heroes must stop Poison Ivy's plants from taking over Gotham while Villains try to help her. Ivy intends to tap into The Green in order to spread her "babies" across the planet.

sections.title: Content
items: : A special springtime vendor kiosk filled with Spring-themed items, trinkets and Costume Style pieces.
Spring-themed Armour Style Sets: Obtainable partly as loot drop and from the seasonal vendors is the Warrior of Spring style set.

sections.title: Story
items: " This is Oracle. *sneezes, delicate blow* Excuse me. Allergies. Spring is in the air, and if you're seeing more pollen than usual, it's because Poison Ivy is spreading spores across Gotham. It's gotten bad enough that Swamp Thing is stepping in. Speak to him in the Watchtower." — Oracle

" Calculator here. Spring is in the air and Poison Ivy is in the Hall of Doom looking for someone to mulch weeds or take over the world for the plants or something. She just got out of Arkham, you know. She might be a little unstable." — Calculator
Heroes must again stop Poison Ivy's plants from taking over Gotham while Villains try to help her.

Veronica Cale teams up with Poison Ivy to capture Swamp Thing to use as a test subject. Cale employs a group of New Villains to capture him, meanwhile, noticing Poison Ivy's minions milling around the sewers, Doctor Sarah Charles employs a group of New Heroes to investigate.

sections.title: Story
items: All hell has broken loose in the streets of Gotham City and inside The Midnight Masquerade Nightclub!

Visit the foyer of the House of Legends or go to the East End safehouse in Gotham City and speak to the Phantom Stranger (Heroes) or The Tap Room in Burnley and speak to Tala (Villains) to receive further instructions.

Each day of the event, look for The Witching Hour in your Mission Journal to complete and earn Spooky Bites! To queue for The Midnight Masquerade, go into your On Duty UI and look under the Events Tab. The mission and the event are available to players at or above Level 10.
The Vault has gotten a bit spookier during The Witching Hour Event. Don't be afraid to check it out!
Shop Teekl's Halloween Bucket for the latest in scarewear, tricks, treats, and creepy items for your Base or League Hall.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The first appearance of this event Eat, Drink and be Scary in 2011, which featured only special items and a beginner-level instance with increased difficulty, was so badly received that SOE revised and restructured the entire event for its next release in 2012.
The Witching Hour is also the name of an ongoing horror series starring a triad of witches known as The Hecatae. It was published by DC Comics, running from 1969 to 1978.

Batwoman's original appearance in DC Universe Online was based off of her original appearance in 2006, however, as of the 2018 seasonal Halloween Event, Batwoman's look was updated to her 2009 "Post-Final Crisis" appearance. The update is possibly to celebrate the character's appearance in three crossover episodes of CW's The Flash, Arrow and Supergirl on December 9th to December 11th, 2018.
Since 2021 the taskmasters and vendors for the event are also located in the House of Legends. Since 2024, they are also located in Gotham City, near Giordano Botanical Gardens.
The Witching Hour Vault last appeared in game during the 2024 event.
Since 2025, event currency prices were discounted approximately 25% of the new "full price" during the first week of the event, and raised to full for the remaining weeks of the event.

sections.title: Overview
items: Valentine's Day is a Valentine's Day themed seasonal event that originally occurred in 2011 and then was discontinued due to quality concerns.

Valentine's Day resurfaced in the DCUO world in 2013 when a mission appeared in all player journals granting access to the styles and feats of the original event. In addition two special Valentine's Day related base items were dropping in The Vault.
This was continued for new player characters in 2014. Additionally two new style items and two new base items were introduced.
In 2015 the event finally was reintroduced as Love Conquers All with all new content. In 2022 new vendors were introduced when the event happened in the House of Legends for the first time.

title: BoP: LexCorp Tower
summary: BoP: LexCorp Tower is a tier 5 challenge in the Birds of Prey episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: BoP: LexCorp Tower is a tier 5 challenge in the Birds of Prey episode.

sections.title: Story
items: An explosion at LexCorp Tower causes a mad rush for Luthor's tech and spurs an investigation into Luthor's fate. Heroes find H.I.V.E. harvesting what they can while Villains work to prevent A.R.G.U.S. from taking Luthor's tech. Work with Superman and the Birds of Prey to battle your way to Luthor's inner sanctum.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: Alongside Superman, you venture to Luthor's Inner Sanctum defeating HIVE (Heroes) or ARGUS (Villains) Agents along the way. Midway you encounter HIVE Master (Heroes) or Steve Trevor (Villains) who is leading the charge in stealing Luthor's tech without even confirming Luthor's fate. You must defeat him to proceed.

If you played Titans: The Machine, then you know how HIVE Master works, especially his laser. Steve Trevor on the other hand, uses brawling combos and has a laser attack similar to HIVE Master's. The boss stands in place and poses if taking deep breaths, then fires a continuous laser while rotating clockwise slowly, causing the laser to sweep 360 degrees and deal massive damage if it touches you. When this occurs, stay relatively close to the boss while slowly going clockwise (like going through a revolving door); you may still be hit once in the beginning, but if you stay in place, the laser will likely hit you twice and KO you.
After the First Subboss, you proceed on. You find clues which add to the mystery of Lex's apparent death along the way.
Then you arrive at Luthor's Inner Sanctum with Superman arriving just in time.
Enter the Main Man, Lobo! He drops in to kill the bounty he was looking for: Lex Luthor. Since Lobo was too late, for the very first time, players battle him in Luthor's Inner Sanctum.
Lobo fights in a Dual Wield weapon style, and has the following special attacks:
Frozen Grasp: Stuns and pulls in his target.
Mangle: Lobo spins rapidly and flails his chain clockwise, continuously damaging and sweeping targets to the direction of the spin.
Grenade Launcher: Although warned by Lethal attack icon, it does not deal a lot damage and is vulnerable to interrupt.

Spacehog: It will periodically appear in the two big holes in the wall and will either do a Flamethrower attack, or a machine gun trail attack that ignores shields and deals massive damage, making it his most dangerous move.

After Lobo is defeated, he retreats and an unknown teleporter is revealed. Superman suggests you go through it after it has been patched up, since he senses that Lois and Jimmy are in trouble. This is done by queuing for BoP: Volcano Mining Facility.

The teleporter would have an icon with a light green circle around it much like many other interactive objects in the game, except that its circle recedes extremely slowly. After waiting for about 30 minutes, it would have fully receded, allowing you to interact with it. You would receive the Volcano Hideout deed, which completes the Clock Watcher feat when collected. While waiting, you also could complete the Busy Work feat since the mobs at the beginning keep respawning after a while.

items: If Lobo is hit while the player is outside of the boss room, they will be briefly locked out before the fight resets, but afterwards Lobo becomes non-interactive and cannot be fought. This could be fixed by going back to previous mobs (some of which would respawn) and getting KO'ed, which allows Lobo to be fought again.
Superman has a health bar in this instance, but his actions are not hindered and he cannot be KO'ed when his health drops to zero.

title: Iconic Vision: Circe's Trial
summary: Iconic Vision: Circe's Trial is a Tier 2 Challenge included in the Amazon Fury Part I Episode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Iconic Vision: Circe's Trial is a Tier 2 Challenge included in the Amazon Fury Part I Episode.

Step into the boots of Circe in this solo Challenge. By using a magical scrying bowl, you will experience a vision of the past and relive the events leading up to the Amazon Civil War that set the events of the Amazon Fury trilogy into motion. Assume the role of Circe as she tries to prove herself a loyal ally to Hippolyta and lend her godly power to the invading Amazon armada.

In Circe's Trial, the player experiences the moment when Circe convinces Hippolyta to allow her to join the war against Gotham City. The player will relive this event through the actions of Circe. The player, as Circe, will have to fight, sneak, or manipulate her way through Themyscira and into the Hippolyta's war.
Assume the role of Circe as she tries to prove herself a loyal ally to Queen Hippolyta and lend her Godlike power to the invading Amazon armada.

sections.title: Objectives
items: Defeat Battlewarden Aevina / High Priestess Teodora [ First Boss Fight]
Complete Trial by Combat [ Final Boss Fight]

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: This challenge may be a bit more difficult than expected as you fight as Circe without your own stats or equipment, and you can't heal yourself with soders either. Move towards the scrying bowl to begin.
Fight through the Amazons. Occasionally it is possible to interact with magic artifacts on the way to make them fight each other instead.
In order to go deeper into the palace, you must first defeat a random subboss, including Battlewarden Aevina or High Priestess Teodora.

Once you make your way into the palace, Hippolyta says that Circe must prove worthy to be on her army. After defeating a few waves of Amazons, you fight the final boss, the Daring Warrior Statue. You can see it in its inert form in the northwestern corner of the room during the previous stages of the fight. If it KO'es you, you only need to defeat it, you do not need to fight the previous waves again.

The Daring Warrior Statue mostly attacks with its weapon, which has a random weapon type every time (including Brawling and Bow). While it has ranged attacks, it does not have a grounding attack and if you are at the ceiling it would occasionally uselessly try to hit you with a lunging melee attack, and since that can't hit and interrupt you, you can also use block-breaking combos with impunity. Do not engage it at melee distance; its Arrow Shot ability shoots a fan of projectiles, and if you are right next to it you get hit by all of it at once and that can do a lot of damage. There is an orange crystal on the west edge of the room, slightly south, which may help.

items: When Circe uses Mirror Image, the clone is summoned with a different combat stance for a few seconds. Its cape also does not blow in the wind like the real Circe's cape does.

title: Tunnel of Lust (Location)
summary: Tunnel of Lust is part of a version of Amusement Mile in Gotham Wastelands during the events of the Sons of Trigon episode, as well as Episode 19.

sections.title: Overview
items: Tunnel of Lust is part of a version of Amusement Mile in Gotham Wastelands during the events of the Sons of Trigon episode, as well as Episode 19.

sections.title: Sons of Trigon
items: The Tunnel of Lust is an attraction adjacent to the Mystery Maze attraction and part of the Ruins of Amusement Mile in Gotham Wastelands, a Gotham-like pocket dimension between between Hell and Earth created by the Sentinels of Magic to trap the demon Trigon and prevent him from possessing his daughter's - Raven's - body and conquering the mortal plane after the events of the Sins of the Father storyline.

The tunnel was claimed by Jacob, the embodiment of Lust and Raven's brother, as his headquarters. There, he harnesses the sinful energy in order to become Trigon's new vessel after his sister Raven refused to take the role, preparing a ritual that will make him even more powerful.

While patrolling Gotham Wastelands with Gizmo, Cheetah decides to enter the place in order to gut Jacob and take his place as the head of the Cult of Lust. In the Hero Garrison, Donna Troy decides to stop him by herself. Jinx enters the Tunnel to find Cheetah, and Zatanna goes after Donna.

Meanwhile, Wonder Woman and Circe each send two new exobyte-heroes and exobyte-villains to stop Jacob from completing his Ritual of Lust. They go through the Mystery Maze, but the heroes come across Jinx, and the villains come cross Zatanna. After winning this altercation, they make their way to the Maintenance Hall and links the Maze to the Tunnel of Lust; while trying to cross a magical barrier, the heroes find Jacob being confronted by Cheetah, while the villains find him being confronted by Donna Troy. Noticing the duo's presence, Jacob enchants the two to protecting him and teleports away. The exobyters manage to win the fight, and discover a vessel nearby that can overload the barrier, finally reaching the Tunnel of Lust per se. After using more vessels to destroy the final barrier, they follow a desperate Devoted Demon to Jacob's location.

The duo faces Jacob, who uses his powers to try and convince them to help with his ritual. In the end, Jacob is conquered by the duo, and his ritual is stopped. Which doesn't prevents him to try again. Eventually, heroes and villains also manage to find Julius, the other son of Trigon and the embodiment of Gluttony, hidden in the kitchen back in the maintenance area, and defeat him as well.

sections.title: Episode 19: Deep Desires
items: After the events of Episode 17, the Raven's brothers have turned against each other, and now Jesse, the embodiment of Envy, enticed Julius, the embodiment of Gluttony, to feel jealousy towards Jacob and claim the Tunnel for himself, which led to a power struggle between Envy and Gluttony. To resolve this, Raven summons a exobyter to back to the Tunnel of Lust, in the same room where Jacob tried to perform his Ritual of Lust - but they find Julius instead, commanding a couple of Lesser Lust Demons. Raven informs them that Julius's power-hunger will destroy all Wastelands and ask them to stop him. Gluttonous Lust Demons and Exarchs of Gluttony are fighting Minor Envy Demons in the Tunnel, and Envy is noticeably outnumbered.

The passage to the Maintenance Hall is sealed with the magical Flames of Gluttony, but the exobyter manages to extinguish them by bathing in the Waters of Lust in the Tunnel. In the Kitchen, they find Jesse begging to Julius for a fraction of his sinful energy, which he denies, enticing Jesse against Raven's ally instead and fleeing. They manage to defeat Jesse and the Burning and Frozen Sin Energies, and proceed to the Maze, where they find one Font of Gluttony vessel in each room, all protected by a shield powered by Gluttonous Energy Hoarders. They begin to destroy the vessels while Julius (poorly) pretends not to care, but find him protecting the last one. During the final fight, the exobyter destroys the final vessel, weakening and defeating Julius for good, and Raven thanks them.
It is unclear who claims the Tunnel after Julius' defeat.

sections.title: Pre-Game History
items: Also known as Sphere of the Gods, the God Sphere is the metaphysical reality where all the gods reside and extra-dimentional beings reside. It is the source of all magic in the positive Multiverse, and it's divided in eight realms, each two opposite of each other: Heaven and Hell, Dream and Nightmare, Skyland and Underworld, and New Genesis and Apokolips. The Sphere of the Gods exists above the Bleed (where all Earths and the House of Legends are located) and below the Source Wall.

sections.title: Wonderverse
items: Unable to accept the stealing and shattering of his crown during the Amazon Fury saga, Zeus decided to take advantage of the damage caused to the Source Wall by the battle against the Bat-God Barbatos in the Dark Multiverse at the end of Metal Part II story, and takes the Source power to make a new crown. His actions caused the fracture of the Godsphere, and all its realms began to fall apart and merge. Nubia, the Wonder Woman of Earth-23, decided to reach for the other Wonder Women for help, as well as for all of the heroes and villains across the Multiverse. After Poseidon's revelation that the God Sphere was crumbling, which would lead to the doom of the mortal world, The Council of Wonder Women and their allies venture into the realms to stop Zeus' power hunger from destroying all existence. After a heated battle with the help of the goddess Hera, and the intrusion of Darkseid and his half-Amazon daughter Grail, the group convinces Zeus to return the Source power to the Wall, fixing the Sphere and saving all planes of existence.

title: The Last Laugh News
summary: THE JOKER RETURNS TO WREAK HAVOC IN DC UNIVERSE™ ONLINE

sections.title: Overview
items: THE JOKER RETURNS TO WREAK HAVOC IN DC UNIVERSE™ ONLINE
Fourth DLC Pack, The Last Laugh, Features Large-Scale Multiplayer Combat, New Light-Powered Legends Characters and an All-New Weapon

SAN DIEGO, Calif. – May 8, 2012 – The battle between heroes and villains in DC Universe™ Online (DCUO) continues as Sony Online Entertainment LLC (SOE) today announced that The Last Laugh, the fourth downloadable content (DLC) pack for DCUO, will be available in June for download on the PC and PlayStation®3 computer entertainment system. The Last Laugh will pit players against each other in high-intensity multiplayer brawls, feature an all-new weapon, and introduce new Light-Powered Legends PvP characters.

“We created this DLC purely for the players that like to take the fight to each other in DCUO's amazing PvP combat," said Jens Andersen, creative director on DC Universe Online. "Our community has continuously asked for more multiplayer action in DCUO, and we wanted to deliver content that fully meets their expectations and pushes PvP to another level. The Last Laugh is the first DLC that we've created that focuses almost entirely on player versus player battles, and it adds an exciting new element as some of DC's greatest heroes and villains join to fight alongside you. Players will have even more opportunities to prove to the world whether heroes or villains will be triumphant."
The Last Laugh will include an all-new weapon, hours of multiplayer gameplay in the Safe Houses and Headquarters, and new Legends PvP characters:
- The Shield – Players can unleash this vicious new weapon to bash their opponents, or hurl it to take them down from a distance.
- Safe House Battles– No one is safe now that heroes and villains can invade each other’s Safe Houses in these four on four battles.
- Graviton Technology Recovery – Players will be tasked with retrieving cutting-edge technology from the hero or villain safe houses. It's a mad dash to grab the most graviton singularity capsules!
- The Rescue – Heroes must rescue hostages, while Villains will be freeing arrested criminals from opposing Safe Houses.

- Bomb Disposal – Stockpiles of explosives have been remotely armed by a mischievous third party! Players must gain control of the Bomb Squad's mech and either neutralize the bombs or use them for dastardly purposes!

Headquarter Battles – In this two-part crusade, 16 players – eight heroes and eight villains – will face off for the ultimate player reward. At the request of Superman, heroes must take over the Hall of Doom, while villains, egged on by The Joker, will breach the Watchtower in order to create chaos.

- Legends Characters – Combat illuminates with the introduction of the first light-powered Legends for multiplayer combat. Players will soon have access to Kilowog, a Green Lantern, and Amon Sur, a member of the Sinestro Corps.

DCUO’s The Last Laugh DLC pack will be accessible for free for the game’s Legendary members and available for purchase for Free and Premium players via the PlayStation®Network in-game Marketplace, and on the PC via the DCUniverseOnline.com website.

sections.title: Content
items: The Trouble Alert has been sounded, and its up to you to answer the call!
Complete all daily challenges to complete the Trouble Alert and earn rewards!

Trouble Alert IconOnce a player warps to the open world zone, the taskmaster for the required daily mission will have the Trouble Alert icon (right) above their name as an aid to quickly locate them. If you do not see the icon or if the taskmaster is otherwise not available for you to interact with, you may need to do something earlier in the introductory mission chain for that Episode. You might also check if the mission is already active on your Journal.

sections.title: Notes
items: The Typhon Underground is notable in that while it starts in Typhon's Monster Invasion, since they require you to go to an enclosed zone, they are not listed in the journal under Typhon's Monster Invasion.

sections.title: Event Rewards
items: Upon completing the event, the player can select a reward. These rewards can only be claimed once per account, and will be added to the active character's inventory.
Current rewards include a choice of Flawless Nth Metal or 500 Ally Favor.
Players should claim their reward before nightly reset occurs. There is no method to Reclaim past rewards for this mission.

sections.title: Known Issues
items: On June 24, 2026, the mission A Rift in Speed was listed in the Events/Daily menu, but with a direction to report to the Wanted Poster in Central City, which is not the correct quest giver. The A Rift in Speed mission has been problematic in the past (per Reddit_Link?_), and the solution is to do the Disturbance in the Speed Force mission as the descriptions are similar . This was tested to work. This occurred in exactly the same way again on July 15, 2026.
On June 26, 2026, the mission Stone Society was mistakenly listed as "Stoned Society" in the Events/Daily menu.

On June 27, 2026, the mission given was titled Finish the Seahorse Challenge in Atlantis, which is actually the objective text for the mission How to Train Your Seahorse. The terminal to start the mission is also not visible from where the Events/Daily Warp button places the player (at the rally point below the bridge where the terminal is located).

On July 13, 2026, the mission given was Crime Spree from Catwoman in BoP: Metropolis. However, this is a villain exclusive mission; completing the hero-specific On the Hunt from Huntress does not count for progress.
On July 30-31, 2026, it was not possible to claim the reward for completing the daily missions. It is unknown if this issue dates back to the most recent update pushed on July 28.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Trouble Alert was the iconic automated global monitoring system and emergency warning system used by the heroes in the classic animated series SuperFriends. Operating directly inside the Hall of Justice, the system relays distress signals and information from the Justice League Satellite directly to the Justice League Computer and acts as the team's primary link to emergencies, natural disasters, global threats, and crimes orchestrated by supervillains.
It is originally found in the Events menu listed under the Daily tab. During double and triple bonus reward events, the tab is renamed as "Double Daily" and "Triple Daily" respectively.

In Ancient Egyptian culture, funerary vessels were designed after Horus' four sons, with the one with jackal head representing Duamutef, one of Horus' sons, commonly used to store the stomach of mummified corpses. Although Anubis, god of funerary rites and guide to Duat, is also represented by a jackal in Egyptian art, he was not represented in canopic jars. It is safe to assume that the Warded Vessels were intended to represent Anubis, as the base item released with the episode that is a jackal-shaped vessel is called Anubis Vessel.
